title: Outreach Ops — Cold Email Infrastructure Monitoring & Automation Platform
headline: Smart Outreach Infrastructure, Simplified.
subhead: A centralized email deliverability monitoring & automated operations hub.
description: Outreach Ops is a centralized outreach management platform designed to simplify cold email operations, monitor deliverability, manage domains, and automate daily tasks. It unites domain health tracking, campaign diagnostics, and inbox warmup oversight into a unified reactive dashboard. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and Vercel Cron, Outreach Ops eliminates manual triage and protects sending reputation.
outcome: Automated cold email domain health monitoring, reducing manual triage by 85% while guaranteeing zero silent deliverability drops.
deliverables: Domain management and monitoring
Email deliverability tracking and verification
Outreach activity tracking and performance insights
Dynamic Account Rules
Campaigns & Clients
Issues & Diagnostics
Automated Monitoring & Notifications
Automated email notifications and scheduled tasks
Responsive dashboard UI with Tailwind CSS
Automated workflows to reduce manual operations
Secure authentication and server side operations
problem: Cold outreach teams running multiple domains face continuous deliverability drops, burned inbox reputations, and blacklisting risks. Before Outreach Ops, operators spent hours every morning manually checking DNS records, bounce rates, and deliverability status across separate platforms without unified alerts or proactive diagnostics.
solution: Engineered a centralized operations command center that connects directly to sending APIs and domain verification providers. Designed idempotent background cron tasks that probe mailbox health every hour, flag delivery anomalies before domain burning occurs, and surface actionable remediation directly inside an intuitive, low-latency dashboard.

title: AI Powered Resume Tailor
headline: AI Powered Resumes, Tailored for Every Job.
description: An AI powered resume optimization tool that tailors resumes to specific job descriptions. It analyzes job requirements, highlights relevant skills and experience, improves resume content, and helps users create ATS friendly resumes to increase their chances of getting noticed by recruiters. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, and Tailwind CSS.
outcome: Simplified the resume customization process by using AI to align resumes with specific job descriptions, improve keyword relevance, and support ATS friendly formatting. Helped job seekers save time and present their skills and experience more effectively for targeted job applications.
deliverables: AI powered resume customization for specific job descriptions
Job description analysis and keyword extraction
ATS friendly resume optimization
AI generated professional summaries and skill suggestions
Work experience refinement and content improvement
Resume keyword matching with job requirements
Personalized resume content for targeted applications
Clean and responsive user interface
Built with Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, and Tailwind CSS
problem: Job seekers often struggle to tailor their resumes for different job openings. Generic resumes may miss important keywords, fail to highlight relevant skills, and perform poorly in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Manually customizing a resume for every application is time consuming and makes it harder to present experience effectively for each role.
solution: Built an AI powered resume tailoring tool that analyzes job descriptions and adapts resume content to match specific job requirements. The solution uses AI to identify relevant skills, suggest improvements, optimize keywords for ATS compatibility, and refine professional summaries and work experience. Users can create targeted resumes more efficiently, improve their job application quality, and present their qualifications clearly for each role.
